Trump threatens ban on Canadian Bombardier jets in US market

U.S. President Donald Trump has threatened to block sales of Canadian planemaker Bombardier aircraft in the United States. The threat, made on Monday, is linked to escalating trade tensions between the U.S. and Canada. Trump stated that Bombardier jets could no longer be sold in the U.S. unless the company builds its planes in America. This action comes as Canada is set to impose retaliatory tariffs on hundreds of U.S. products on Tuesday. Trump accused Canada of "unjust and unfair" trade practices.
